title: ever ORLA|Floral Embroidered Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Tulle Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This is the kind of formal dress that does the work for you. The V-neck opens up the neckline (great if you??£¤re fuller in the bust), and the sheer flutter sleeves give you that little bit of arm coverage without feeling warm or bulky. The embroidered sequin detailing adds a dressed-up finish for photos, while the tulle skirt falls away from the body so it doesn‘t cling at the hips or thighs. If you want something that looks special but still feels easy to move in, this one fits.

Best For

  • Formal wedding guest dresses
  • Black-tie optional events
  • Galas and evening receptions
  • Arm coverage without full sleeves
  • Bust-friendly neckline, a skirt that doesn??£¤t cling


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretchy.
